text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah recovering after a successful colon surgery on Saturday.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives visiting Croatian Prime Minister Zlacto Matesa. They discuss political and economic ties.
- Syria offers big incentives to foreign investors, Syrian Economy and Foreign Trade Minister Mohammed Imadi says.

- Constitutional Court on Saturday rejected 29 cases by debtors challenging a law that governs the settlement of private sector debts owed to the state with an original value of $20 billion. Many debtors have started to pay their debts according to the 1994 programme.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange sets new records. Shares worth 89.7 million dinars ($296 million) were traded on Saturday while the index rose to 2,241 points.
